ruleDefinitions.name: Service Registry Key Deleted Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "delete" flag on services registry key. Often used by attacker to remove AV software services

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ delete\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\services\\\\.*"))
